capabilities: Display base entries as cards with thumbnails, snippets, and properties
Select multiple entries and bulk-edit tags, properties, and draft status
Delete files with automatic parent-folder and unused-attachment cleanup
Run a configured Obsidian command from a card title without opening the file
Show or hide individual toolbar buttons and pick the view icon
extras: The author notes it is part of the Vault CMS project and promotes Zeku, a paid desktop writing app from the same developer for the same workflow.
problem: Bases only displays entries as tables or cards for viewing; it lacks batch editing, publish/draft status management, and cleanup when deleting folder-based content.

relations.evidence: inspired by Dynamic Views and Multi-Properties that provides CMS-like functionality to bases
Astro Composer implements this pattern for its "Rename current content" command

summary: Adds a card-based CMS view to Obsidian Bases with bulk tag, property, and publish/draft operations plus smart deletion.
